labels._title: Conway's Law: siloed teams lead to siloed architectures
labels._desc: On the left, three siloed functional teams stacked vertically: UI specialists, middleware specialists and DBAs. On the right, a database feeds an application made of three components, which in turn feeds a user interface document. A dashed line separates the teams from the architecture.
